industry.structure: Enterprise AI application software is concentrated among hyperscalers (Microsoft, Google, Amazon) bundling AI with cloud, plus specialized vendors like C3.ai, Palantir, and ServiceNow extensions. Switching costs depend on integration depth; pricing power is unproven at scale.
industry.share_shift: Hyperscalers are gaining share in generic AI workloads; C3.ai competes on domain-specific applications and Federal verticals but FY2026 revenue decline suggests share loss or deal timing headwinds.
industry.trend: Generative AI expanded enterprise budgets but also raised build-vs-buy pressure; customers demand proof of ROI and may defer large platform commits during macro uncertainty.
